column1: # Consistency fixes after the "Lord" review: pronouns follow their "Lord".

column6: call upon him: the same Lord (Jesus, 10:9)
call on him, believe in him: the Lord of 10:12-13
in whom, of whom: the Lord of 10:12-13
stronger than he: the Lord of the Lord's table
the only Potentate: God, who shows Christ's appearing (6:14), as Lord of lords here
